ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by the 'trial of the world' in his sermons?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes the *dunya* not merely as a temporary abode but as a profound *fitnah* (trial) that tests the believer's spiritual resilience and prioritization of the Hereafter. This warning aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition of viewing worldly attachment as the primary obstacle to *ma'rifah* (gnosis), urging believers to cultivate detachment (*zuhd*) while remaining active in the world. The emphasis on 'fitnah' underscores the dynamic nature of this trial, requiring constant vigilance rather than passive withdrawal.
